blocks.text: both, either, neither — faqat ikki narsa haqida

Bu uch so'z faqat **ikki** kishi yoki narsa haqida gapirganda ishlatiladi. O'zbekchada: **ikkalasi ham** (both), **ikkalasidan biri** / **istalgani** (either), **hech biri** / **ikkalasi ham ... emas** (neither). Ikkidan ko'p bo'lsa — **all**, **any**, **none** (80–81-darslar): **both** my sisters (ikkita opam), lekin **all** my sisters (uch va undan ko'p).

**both** dan keyin ot **ko'plikda**, fe'l ham ko'plikda: **both** hotels **are** ... Ega olmosh bo'lsa, **both** fe'ldan oldin yoki **be** dan keyin turadi: We **both** like tea. They **are both** from Bukhara. O'zbekchadagi «ikkala**miz** ham», «ikkala**si** ham» shu ma'noni beradi.

items.text: **Both** my grandmothers live in the same village.
We were **both** very nervous before the interview.
items.translation: Suhbat oldidan **ikkalamiz ham** juda hayajonlangan edik.

blocks.text: **either** dan keyin ot **birlikda**: **either** day, **either** colour. Darak gapda — «ikkalasidan biri, qaysi biri bo'lsa ham»: Come on **either** day (istalgan kuni keling). Savolda — «birortasi»: Do you know **either** of them? Inkor gapda **not ... either** — «hech biri»: I **don't** like **either** colour. **on either side** = ikkala tomonda ham.

items.text: The two shirts cost the same, so take **either**.
items.translation: Ikkala ko'ylakning narxi bir xil, **istalganini** oling.

blocks.text: **neither** dan keyin ot **birlikda**, fe'l esa **tasdiqda** — inkor allaqachon **neither** ning ichida. O'zbekchada esa «Ikkalasi **ham** kel**ma**di» — inkor fe'lda. Shuning uchun o'zbeklar «Both of them didn't come» deb yuboradi; inglizlar buni **Neither of them came** deydi. **neither** = **not ... either**: I like **neither** film = I **don't** like **either** film.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «Both of them didn't come.» → **Neither of them came.**; «Neither of them didn't know.» → **Neither of them knew.** (ikki inkor yo'q); «both hotel» → **both hotels**; «neither hotels» → **neither hotel**; «Both are not good.» → **Neither is good.**; uch va undan ko'p narsa haqida «both» → **all** (both — faqat ikkita).
both of, either of, neither of

Aniq ikki narsa haqida **of** + **the / my / these / us / them**: **both of** the children, **either of** my bikes, **neither of** us. Olmosh bilan **of** shart: **both of them** («both them» emas). **both** bilan **of** ni tushirish mumkin: **both** my parents = **both of** my parents. **neither of** / **either of** + ko'plikdan keyin fe'l odatda birlikda (Neither of them **is** ready), so'zlashuvda ko'plik ham uchraydi.

items.text: **Both of** the bridges in the town are very old.
Is **either of** you free on Thursday?

blocks.text: both ... and, either ... or, neither ... nor

Ikki narsani bog'lash uchun: **both** A **and** B — A **ham**, B **ham**; **either** A **or** B — **yo** A, **yo** B; **neither** A **nor** B — **na** A, **na** B. Qiziq tomoni: o'zbekcha «na ... na» ham ko'pincha tasdiq fe'l bilan keladi (**Na** Aziz, **na** Bekzod biladi), xuddi inglizchadagidek: **Neither** Aziz **nor** Bekzod **knows**.

rows: **Neither** the bus **nor** the train was on time.

blocks.text: Ikki variantli savolga qisqa javob: **Both.** (ikkalasi ham), **Neither.** (hech biri), **Either.** (farqi yo'q, istalgani): Tea or coffee? — **Either**, thanks. «Me neither» va «Neither do I» haqida → 42-dars.

Eslab qolish: **both** — **b**irga ikkalasi (ko'plik). **either** — bittasi, qaysi biri bo'lsa ham (birlik). **n**either — **n**o, ikkalasi ham emas (birlik + tasdiq fe'l). «Ikkalasi ham ... -ma-» ni ko'rsangiz — **neither**.
Bog'liq darslar: ikkidan ko'p narsa uchun **all / most / some / none** → 80–81-darslar; **so am I / neither do I** → 42-dars; bitta inkor qoidasi → 77–78-darslar.

rows: Take **either** seat. I don't like **either** seat.
**both of / either of / neither of** + the / my / them
ham ... ham / yo ... yo / na ... na

examples.title: **both** + plural: both hotels, we both ...
examples.description: **both** — «ikkalasi ham». Ot va fe'l ko'plikda: **Both** restaurants **are** good. Olmosh bilan: We **both** ..., They are **both** ...

sentences.text: **Both** my parents are teachers.
sentences.translation: Ota-onamning **ikkalasi ham** o'qituvchi.

sentences.text: **Both** restaurants are good, so you can choose.
sentences.translation: **Ikkala** restoran **ham** yaxshi, xohlaganingizni tanlang.

sentences.text: Aziz has two sisters, and **both** of them live in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Azizning ikkita opasi bor, **ikkalasi ham** Toshkentda yashaydi.

sentences.text: I've got two cats, and **both** are black.
sentences.translation: Ikkita mushugim bor, **ikkalasi ham** qora.

sentences.text: We **both** love football, but we support different teams.
sentences.translation: **Ikkalamiz ham** futbolni yaxshi ko'ramiz, lekin turli jamoalarga ishqibozmiz.

sentences.text: Hold the box with **both** hands — it's heavy.
sentences.translation: Qutini **ikkala** qo'lingiz bilan ushlang — og'ir.

sentences.text: Tom and Sarah are **both** from Oxford.
sentences.translation: Tom bilan Sara **ikkalasi ham** Oksforddan.

sentences.text: **Both** buses stop near the bazaar.
sentences.translation: **Ikkala** avtobus **ham** bozor yaqinida to'xtaydi.

sentences.text: There are shops on **both** sides of the street.
sentences.translation: Ko'chaning **ikkala** tomonida **ham** do'konlar bor.

sentences.text: Bekzod and his brother **both** work in the same bank.
sentences.translation: Bekzod va akasi **ikkalasi ham** bitta bankda ishlaydi.

examples.title: **neither** + singular — one negative
examples.description: **neither** — «hech biri». Ot birlikda, fe'l **tasdiqda**: **Neither** answer **is** correct. O'zbekchada «Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri **emas**» — inkor fe'lda; inglizchada inkor faqat **neither** da.

sentences.text: **Neither** answer is correct.
sentences.translation: Javoblarning **hech biri** to'g'ri **emas**.

sentences.text: I tried two shops, but **neither** shop had milk.
sentences.translation: Ikkita do'konga kirdim, lekin **ikkalasida ham** sut **yo'q** edi.

sentences.text: **Neither** of my brothers likes sport.
sentences.translation: Akalarimning **ikkalasi ham** sportni **yoqtirmaydi**.

sentences.text: We looked at two flats, but **neither** had a balcony.
sentences.translation: Ikkita kvartirani ko'rdik, lekin **hech birida** balkon **yo'q** edi.

sentences.text: Madina and Dilnoza were invited, but **neither** of them came.
sentences.translation: Madina bilan Dilnoza taklif qilingan edi, lekin **ikkalasi ham kelmadi**.

sentences.text: **Neither** road is safe in winter.
sentences.translation: Qishda **ikkala** yo'l **ham** xavfsiz **emas**.

sentences.text: The two films were long, and **neither** was interesting.
sentences.translation: Ikkala film ham uzun edi, **hech biri** qiziqarli **emas** edi.

sentences.text: Sarah has two phones, but **neither** works properly.
sentences.translation: Saraning ikkita telefoni bor, lekin **hech biri** yaxshi **ishlamaydi**.

sentences.text: Tom asked his parents for money, but **neither** of them said yes.
sentences.translation: Tom ota-onasidan pul so'radi, lekin **ikkalasi ham** rozi **bo'lmadi**.

sentences.text: In the first half **neither** team scored.
sentences.translation: Birinchi bo'limda **ikkala** jamoa **ham** gol **urmadi**.

examples.title: **either**: one of two / not ... either
examples.description: **either** + birlik — «istalgani, qaysi biri bo'lsa ham»: You can sit on **either** side. Inkorda **not ... either** = «hech biri»: I don't like **either** colour.

sentences.text: You can sit on **either** side of the table.
sentences.translation: Stolning **istalgan** tomoniga o'tirishingiz mumkin.

sentences.text: There are two roads to the village, and you can take **either**.
sentences.translation: Qishloqqa ikkita yo'l bor, **istalganidan** borishingiz mumkin.

sentences.text: Come on Saturday or Sunday — **either** day is fine for me.
sentences.translation: Shanba yoki yakshanba keling — men uchun **qaysi kuni bo'lsa ham** mayli.

sentences.text: I don't like **either** colour — have you got it in green?
sentences.translation: **Ikkala** rang **ham** menga **yoqmayapti** — yashili bormi?

sentences.text: Do you know **either** of these men?
sentences.translation: Bu ikki kishining **birortasini** taniysizmi?

sentences.text: Bekzod didn't want to go to **either** party.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **ikkala** ziyofatga **ham borishni xohlamadi**.

sentences.text: Emma can write with **either** hand.
sentences.translation: Emma **ikkala** qo'li bilan **ham** yoza oladi.

sentences.text: There's a bus stop on **either** side of the road.
sentences.translation: Yo'lning **ikkala** tomonida **ham** bekat bor.

sentences.text: I can't answer **either** question — they're both very difficult.
sentences.translation: **Hech bir** savolga javob bera **olmayman** — ikkalasi ham juda qiyin.

sentences.text: Has **either** of your parents been to London?
sentences.translation: Ota-onangizdan **birortasi** Londonda bo'lganmi?

examples.title: **both of** / **either of** / **neither of** + the / them
examples.description: Aniq ikki narsa haqida — **of** + the / my / these / us / them: **both of** them, **neither of** us, **either of** my bikes. Olmosh bilan **of** shart.

sentences.text: **Both of** these jackets look nice on you.
sentences.translation: Bu kurtkalarning **ikkalasi ham** sizga yarashyapti.

sentences.text: **Neither of** us knew the answer.
sentences.translation: **Ikkalamiz ham** javobni **bilmasdik**.

sentences.text: You can borrow **either of** my bikes.
sentences.translation: Velosipedlarimning **istalganini** olib turishingiz mumkin.

sentences.text: My grandparents are eighty, but **both of** them are very active.
sentences.translation: Bobom va buvim sakson yoshda, lekin **ikkalasi ham** juda faol.

sentences.text: I called Aziz and Bekzod, but **neither of** them answered.
sentences.translation: Aziz bilan Bekzodga qo'ng'iroq qildim, lekin **ikkalasi ham** javob **bermadi**.

sentences.text: Have **either of** you seen my glasses?
sentences.translation: **Birortangiz** ko'zoynagimni ko'rdingizmi?

sentences.text: We invited Tom and Emma, and **both of** them came with presents.
sentences.translation: Tom bilan Emmani taklif qildik, **ikkalasi ham** sovg'a bilan keldi.

sentences.text: I've met Sarah's parents, but I don't remember **either of** them.
sentences.translation: Saraning ota-onasi bilan tanishganman, lekin **ikkalasini ham eslay olmayman**.

sentences.text: **Neither of** the restaurants in the village was open on Monday.
sentences.translation: Qishloqdagi **ikkala** restoran **ham** dushanba kuni **ochiq emas** edi.

sentences.text: Madina has two daughters, and **both of** them study medicine in Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Madinaning ikkita qizi bor, **ikkalasi ham** Samarqandda tibbiyot o'qiydi.

examples.title: **both** ... **and**, **either** ... **or**, **neither** ... **nor**
examples.description: Ikki narsani bog'lash: **both** A **and** B (A ham, B ham), **either** A **or** B (yo A, yo B), **neither** A **nor** B (na A, na B). **neither ... nor** bilan fe'l tasdiqda.

sentences.text: **Both** Tashkent **and** Samarkand have international airports.
sentences.translation: Toshkentda **ham**, Samarqandda **ham** xalqaro aeroport bor.

sentences.text: We can go **either** by train **or** by bus.
sentences.translation: **Yo** poyezdda, **yo** avtobusda borishimiz mumkin.

sentences.text: **Neither** Aziz **nor** his wife speaks English.
sentences.translation: **Na** Aziz, **na** uning xotini inglizcha gapiradi.

sentences.text: The job is **both** interesting **and** well paid.
sentences.translation: Bu ish **ham** qiziqarli, **ham** yaxshi maoshli.

sentences.text: You can pay **either** in cash **or** by card.
sentences.translation: **Yo** naqd pulda, **yo** karta bilan to'lashingiz mumkin.

sentences.text: Sarah eats **neither** meat **nor** fish.
sentences.translation: Sara **na** go'sht, **na** baliq yeydi.

sentences.text: **Either** call me **or** send a message when you arrive.
sentences.translation: Yetib kelganingizda **yo** qo'ng'iroq qiling, **yo** xabar yozing.

sentences.text: My brother is **both** a student **and** a part-time waiter.
sentences.translation: Akam **ham** talaba, **ham** yarim stavkada ofitsiant.

sentences.text: The hotel had **neither** hot water **nor** WiFi.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonada **na** issiq suv, **na** WiFi bor edi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza wants to study **either** medicine **or** law after school.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza maktabdan keyin **yo** tibbiyot, **yo** huquqshunoslik bo'yicha o'qimoqchi.

examples.title: Short answers: **Both**. **Neither**. **Either**.
examples.description: Ikki variantli savolga qisqa javob: **Both.** (ikkalasi ham), **Neither.** (hech biri), **Either.** (farqi yo'q, istalgani).

sentences.text: Tea or coffee? — **Either** — I don't mind.
sentences.translation: Choymi yoki qahvami? — **Qaysi biri bo'lsa ham** — farqi yo'q.

sentences.text: Which shoes do you prefer, the black ones or the brown ones? — **Neither**, really.
sentences.translation: Qaysi tufli ko'proq yoqadi — qoralarimi yoki jigarranglarimi? — Rostini aytsam, **hech biri**.

sentences.text: Do you speak English or Russian? — **Both**, and a little Turkish too.
sentences.translation: Inglizcha gapirasizmi yoki ruscha? — **Ikkalasini ham**, ozgina turkchani ham.

sentences.text: Is your flat in the centre or near the airport? — **Neither**. It's in Chilanzar.
sentences.translation: Kvartirangiz markazdami yoki aeroport yaqinidami? — **Hech birida**. Chilonzorda.

sentences.text: Shall we meet on Friday or Saturday? — **Either** day is fine.
sentences.translation: Juma kuni uchrashamizmi yoki shanba? — **Qaysi kuni bo'lsa ham** mayli.

sentences.text: Did you buy the red dress or the blue one? — **Both**! I couldn't decide.
sentences.translation: Qizil ko'ylakni oldingizmi yoki ko'kinimi? — **Ikkalasini ham**! Tanlay olmadim.

sentences.text: Which of the two films did you like? — **Neither** of them, to be honest.
sentences.translation: Ikki filmdan qaysi biri yoqdi? — Rostini aytsam, **hech biri**.

sentences.text: Are Aziz and Bekzod coming tonight? — Yes, **both** of them.
sentences.translation: Aziz bilan Bekzod bugun kechqurun keladimi? — Ha, **ikkalasi ham**.

sentences.text: Would you like rice or potatoes with your fish? — **Neither**, thanks — just salad.
sentences.translation: Baliq bilan guruch beraymi yoki kartoshka? — Rahmat, **hech biri** kerak emas — faqat salat.

sentences.text: Can I use your pen or your pencil? — **Either** — they're both on the desk.
sentences.translation: Ruchkangizni olsam bo'ladimi yoki qalamingizni? — **Istalganini** oling — ikkalasi ham stol ustida.

examples.title: Looking at two flats: Do you like **either** of them?
examples.description: Ikki kvartirani tanlash haqida suhbat: **both**, **either**, **neither** va **either ... or** — bitta vaziyatda.

sentences.text: — We've seen two flats today. Do you like **either** of them?
sentences.translation: — Bugun ikkita kvartira ko'rdik. **Birortasi** sizga yoqdimi?

sentences.text: — Well, **both** flats are nice, but they're quite different.
sentences.translation: — Xo'sh, **ikkala** kvartira **ham** yaxshi, lekin bir-biridan ancha farq qiladi.

sentences.text: — Is **either** of them near your office?
sentences.translation: — **Birortasi** ishxonangiz yaqinidami?

sentences.text: — No, **neither** of them is near. I'll need to take the metro.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, **hech biri** yaqin **emas**. Metroda yurishimga to'g'ri keladi.

sentences.text: — What about the price? Are they **both** expensive?
sentences.translation: — Narxi-chi? **Ikkalasi ham** qimmatmi?

sentences.text: — Yes, **both** cost about six hundred pounds a month.
sentences.translation: — Ha, **ikkalasi ham** oyiga olti yuz funt atrofida.

sentences.text: — Has **either** of them got a garden?
sentences.translation: — **Birortasining** bog'i bormi?

sentences.text: — The first has a small garden, but **neither** has a garage.
sentences.translation: — Birinchisida kichik bog' bor, lekin **hech birida** garaj **yo'q**.

sentences.text: — Hmm. I think we need to see **both** flats again at the weekend.
sentences.translation: — Hmm. Menimcha, dam olish kunlari **ikkala** kvartirani **ham** yana ko'rishimiz kerak.

sentences.text: — Good idea. **Either** Saturday **or** Sunday is fine for me.
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi fikr. Men uchun **yo** shanba, **yo** yakshanba bo'laveradi.

examples.title: Mixed practice: **both**, **either**, **neither**
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: **both** + ko'plik, **either / neither** + birlik, **of** bilan shakllar va juft bog'lovchilar.

sentences.text: **Both** of my grandfathers were farmers.
sentences.translation: **Ikkala** bobom **ham** dehqon bo'lgan.

sentences.text: **Neither** of the two answers is right — try again.
sentences.translation: Ikki javobning **hech biri** to'g'ri **emas** — qaytadan urinib ko'ring.

sentences.text: You can use **either** door to enter the building.
sentences.translation: Binoga **istalgan** eshikdan kirishingiz mumkin.

sentences.text: I liked **both** books, but I didn't like **either** film.
sentences.translation: Menga **ikkala** kitob **ham** yoqdi, lekin filmlarning **hech biri** yoqmadi.

sentences.text: Madina and Sarah are **both** studying medicine.
sentences.translation: Madina bilan Sara **ikkalasi ham** tibbiyot o'qiyapti.

sentences.text: **Neither** Tom **nor** Emma knew about the party.
sentences.translation: Ziyofat haqida **na** Tom, **na** Emma bilardi.

sentences.text: Do you want to go out or stay at home? — **Either** is fine with me.
sentences.translation: Tashqariga chiqamizmi yoki uyda qolamizmi? — Men uchun **farqi yo'q**.

sentences.text: We have two cars, but **neither** of them is new.
sentences.translation: Ikkita mashinamiz bor, lekin **hech biri** yangi **emas**.

sentences.text: Aziz is **both** clever **and** hard-working.
sentences.translation: Aziz **ham** aqlli, **ham** mehnatkash.

sentences.text: I can meet you **either** before lunch **or** after five.
sentences.translation: Siz bilan **yo** tushlikdan oldin, **yo** soat beshdan keyin uchrashishim mumkin.
